svg.text: 0x4000000000000000L is 2^62: it marks a subpage handle, so a handle is never 0 even for unit 0.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Offset of the unit = runOffset(memoryMapIdx) + (bitmapIdx & 0x3FFFFFFF) × elemSize + chunk offset.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4.1.53 replaced this layout: its handles encode run offset, page count, used/subpage flags and bitmap index.
